root_cause: Netlify observability records real scheduled social-learning-evaluate POST attempts returning HTTP 499 after ~15 seconds repeatedly on 2026-10-24; no new social_learning_evaluations since 2026-09-19. The evaluator walked every due 24/48/72h window without a per-run bound and its store defaults to canonical, leaving 116 owned-brand posts and 508 provider snapshots in tenant bedrijfsgeheugen without any formal evaluations.
fix: Use the one preexisting hourly Netlify scheduled evaluator, now bounded to at most two due windows per tenant, one fresh-first and one rotating old-due window when available. Explicitly read the two verified existing social tenants via distinct scoped stores without aliasing or merging, and keep missing historical snapshots as typed evidence obligations.
prevention_rule: No new scheduler, no unlimited per-hour backfill, no fake retrospectively observed snapshots, no silent completion of due social-learning obligations, no cross-tenant source leakage, no unproven post win or auto publication. Provider 204 plus new tenant-scoped evaluations + learning application readback is required to mark successful.
terminal_rule: Protected Required+CodeQL, merged exact main, Netlify production function deployed, next scheduled provider POST returns success and independently observed social_learning_evaluations appear in proper tenant(s). A 204 with zero outcomes never proves lift.
